passages.text: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own palace, Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram had given him and settled Israelites there.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He built the house of the LORD.
He also built his own palace.
Twenty years passed while Solomon built these buildings.
Hiram gave some cities to Solomon.
Solomon rebuilt these cities.
Solomon settled Israelites in these cities.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃ וְהֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן חוּרָם֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֹתָ֑ם וַיּ֥וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it.
passages.sermon: Solomon was king of Israel.\r\nSolomon went to Hamath-zobah.\r\nSolomon captured Hamath-zobah.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ חֲמָ֣ת צוֹבָ֔ה וַיֶּחֱזַ֖ק עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, in addition to all the store cities that he had built in Hamath.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon built Tadmor.
Tadmor was in the wilderness.
Solomon also built store cities.
These store cities were in Hamath.
passages.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת־ תַּדְמֹ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י הַֽמִּסְכְּנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּחֲמָֽת׃

passages.text: He rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars, as well as Baalath, all the store cities that belonged to Solomon, and all the cities for his chariots and horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and throughout the land of his dominion.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king over Israel.
Solomon rebuilt Upper Beth-horon.
Solomon rebuilt Lower Beth-horon.
He made these cities strong.
He built walls around them.
He put gates and bars on them.
Solomon also built Baalath.
He built all the store cities that belonged to him.
He built cities for his chariots.
He built cities for his horsemen.
Solomon built anything he wanted.
He built in Jerusalem.
He built in Lebanon.
He built in every part of his kingdom.
passages.original: וַיִּ֜בֶן אֶת־ בֵּ֤ית חוֹרוֹן֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן הַתַּחְתּ֑וֹן עָרֵ֣י מָצ֔וֹר חוֹמ֖וֹת דְּלָתַ֥יִם וּבְרִֽיחַ׃ וְאֶֽת־ בַּעֲלָ֗ת וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ עָרֵ֤י הַֽמִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְאֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַפָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִבְנ֤וֹת בִּירֽוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וּבַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: As for all the people who remained of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (the people who were not Israelites)— their descendants who remained in the land, those whom the Israelites were unable to destroy—Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers, as they are to this day.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Some people lived in the land who were not Israelites.
These people were Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Their descendants also remained in the land.
The Israelites could not destroy all of them.
Solomon made these people work as forced laborers.
They still serve as forced laborers to this day.
passages.original: כָּל־ הָ֠עָם הַנּוֹתָ֨ר מִן־ הַחִתִּ֜י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֤י וְהַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְהַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה׃ מִן־ בְּנֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נוֹתְר֤וּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ כִלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲלֵ֤ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְמַ֔ס עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slave labor, because they were his men of war, his officers and captains, and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He did not make any Israelites do forced labor.
He did not assign them as slaves for his work.
The Israelites were his soldiers.
They were his men of war.
They were his officers.
They were his captains.
They were commanders of his chariots.
They were commanders of his cavalry.
passages.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־ נָתַ֧ן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה לַעֲבָדִ֖ים לִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ כִּי־ הֵ֜מָּה אַנְשֵׁ֤י מִלְחָמָה֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י שָׁלִישָׁ֔יו וְשָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃פ

passages.text: They were also the chief officers for King Solomon: 250 supervisors.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon had chief officers.
These officers served as supervisors.
There were 250 supervisors.
These supervisors ruled over the people.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה שָׂרֵ֤י הַנְּצִיבִים אֲשֶׁר־ לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם הָרֹדִ֖ים בָּעָֽם׃

passages.text: Solomon brought the daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her. For he said, “My wife must not live in the house of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the LORD has entered are holy.”
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon had a wife who was the daughter of Pharaoh.
Solomon built a palace for her.
Solomon brought Pharaoh’s daughter up from the City of David to this palace.
Solomon said, “My wife must not live in the house of David, king of Israel.”
He said this because the house of David was holy.
The ark of the LORD had entered those places.
Solomon believed that places where the ark of the LORD had entered are holy.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֗ה הֶעֱלָ֤ה שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מֵעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד לַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽנָה־ לָ֑הּ כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר לֹא־ תֵשֵׁ֨ב אִשָּׁ֥ה לִי֙ בְּבֵית֙ דָּוִ֣יד מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּי־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽאָ֥ה אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: At that time Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD he had built in front of the portico.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
At that time, Solomon offered burnt offerings.
He offered them to the LORD.
He used the altar of the LORD.
Solomon had built this altar.
The altar stood in front of the portico.
passages.original: אָ֣ז הֶעֱלָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה עֹל֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה עַ֚ל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָאוּלָֽם׃

passages.text: He observed the daily requirement for offerings according to the commandment of Moses for Sabbaths, New Moons, and the three annual appointed feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Tabernacles.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He followed the commandment of Moses.
He offered sacrifices every day as required.
He made offerings on the Sabbaths.
He made offerings on the New Moons.
He made offerings at the appointed feasts.
There were three main feasts each year.
He offered sacrifices at the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
He offered sacrifices at the Feast of Weeks.
He offered sacrifices at the Feast of Tabernacles.
passages.original: וּבִדְבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּי֗וֹם לְהַעֲלוֹת֙ כְּמִצְוַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַשַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וְלַמּ֣וֹעֲד֔וֹת שָׁל֥וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: In keeping with the ordinances of his father David, Solomon appointed the divisions of the priests over their service, and the Levites for their duties to offer praise and to minister before the priests according to the daily requirement. He also appointed gatekeepers by their divisions at each gate, for this had been the command of David, the man of God.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
David was Solomon’s father.
David was called the man of God.
David gave commands for the service in the temple.
Solomon followed the commands of his father David.
Solomon appointed the priests in groups for their service.
Solomon gave each group of priests their work.
Solomon appointed the Levites for their duties.
The Levites praised God.
The Levites served before the priests.
The Levites did their work every day.
Solomon appointed the gatekeepers in groups.
Each group of gatekeepers watched over a gate.
Solomon did this because David had commanded it.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד כְּמִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּֽוִיד־ אָ֠בִיו אֶת־ מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים עַל־ עֲבֹדָתָ֗ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם עַל־ מִ֠שְׁמְרוֹתָם לְהַלֵּ֨ל וּלְשָׁרֵ֜ת נֶ֤גֶד הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לִדְבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים בְּמַחְלְקוֹתָ֖ם לְשַׁ֣עַר וָשָׁ֑עַר כִּ֣י כֵ֔ן מִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֥יד אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: They did not turn aside from the king’s command regarding the priests or the Levites or any matter concerning the treasuries.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He gave commands to the priests and the Levites.
The priests and the Levites obeyed the king’s commands.
They did not turn aside from his instructions.
They followed his orders in every matter.
They obeyed him in all things concerning the treasuries.
passages.original: וְלֹ֣א סָרוּ֩ מִצְוַ֨ת הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם לְכָל־ דָּבָ֖ר וְלָאֹצָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Thus all the work of Solomon was carried out, from the day the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was completed.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon built the house of the LORD.
Workers began on the day they laid the foundation.
They continued the work until they finished everything.
They completed all the work for the house of the LORD.
The house of the LORD was finished.
passages.original: וַתִּכֹּן֙ כָּל־ מְלֶ֣אכֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַד־ הַיּ֛וֹם מוּסַ֥ד בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וְעַד־ כְּלֹת֑וֹ שָׁלֵ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth on the coast of Edom.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon was the ruler of Israel.
Solomon traveled to Ezion-geber.
Ezion-geber was a location.
Solomon also went to Eloth.
Eloth was on the coast.
This coast was in the land of Edom.
passages.original: אָז֩ הָלַ֨ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה לְעֶצְיֽוֹן־ גֶּ֧בֶר וְאֶל־ אֵיל֛וֹת עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: So Hiram sent him ships captained by his servants, along with crews of experienced sailors. They went with Solomon’s servants to Ophir and acquired from there 450 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Hiram sent ships to Solomon.
Hiram sent his own servants to command the ships.
Hiram sent crews who were skilled sailors.
These sailors joined with Solomon’s servants.
They traveled together to Ophir.
They took 450 talents of gold from Ophir.
They brought the gold to King Solomon.
passages.original: וַיִּֽשְׁלַֽח־ לוֹ֩ חוּרָ֨ם בְּיַד־ עֲבָדָ֜יו אוֹנִיּוֹת וַעֲבָדִים֮ י֣וֹדְעֵי יָם֒ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עִם־ עַבְדֵ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אוֹפִ֔ירָה וַיִּקְח֣וּ מִשָּׁ֔ם אַרְבַּע־ מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים כִּכַּ֣ר זָהָ֑ב וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃פ
